changedCatalogRecords.name: dsh-version-guard
changedCatalogRecords.summaryEn: Snapshots plugin versions and profile configuration, with an independent recovery page to restore a known-good configuration when DSH cannot start.
changedCatalogRecords.summaryZh: 记录插件版本与 profile 配置快照，在 DSH 无法启动时通过独立恢复页回退到已知可用配置。
changedCatalogRecords.noteEn: Native manifest-to-patch structure confirmed at the pinned commit. Local profile configuration and snapshots are written; explicit dependency synchronization runs pnpm install --ignore-scripts. Runtime compatibility with a host version was not tested.
changedCatalogRecords.noteZh: 固定 commit 上已确认 manifest 与 patch 对应结构；会写入本地 profile 配置和快照，显式依赖同步运行 pnpm install --ignore-scripts，尚未实测具体宿主版本兼容性。

changedCatalogRecords.name: Archive Management / 归档管理
changedCatalogRecords.summaryEn: Manage archived and unarchived chats with search, previews, tags and notes, workspace archiving, ZIP backups, selected actions, a Recycle Bin, storage and retention, origins and branches, and automatic residual chat checks.
changedCatalogRecords.summaryZh: 管理已归档与未归档会话，支持搜索、预览、标签备注、工作区归档、ZIP 备份、选择操作、回收站恢复、空间与保留策略、来源分支和自动残留会话检查。
changedCatalogRecords.noteEn: Version 1.5.2 manifest, patch, licenses, install identity, and user-facing capabilities checked at the pinned release commit. dsh.engines.dsh declares a host range; this directory does not certify runtime compatibility. lib/about.js checks public npm version metadata with a bodyless GET. This evidence refresh did not execute the plugin.
changedCatalogRecords.noteZh: 已按 1.5.2 固定发布提交静态核对 manifest、patch、许可证、安装身份与用户可见功能。dsh.engines.dsh 声明宿主范围，本目录不认证运行时兼容性。lib/about.js 使用无请求体的 GET 检查公开 npm 版本元数据。本次证据更新未执行插件。
